contentPattern.structure: rotating slides; each slide = full-bleed image + overlay panel (heading + paragraph + CTA)

suitableFor: full-width rotating hero banners with overlaid heading + intro text + CTA per slide
landing-page top-of-page image carousels with slide indicators and prev/next controls
notSuitableFor: single static full-bleed banner image with no rotation (use hero)
single image + white intro text panel with no rotation (use columns-intro)
